_narrowed_by_owner_2026_08_17: AMENDED after the lane's AWAIT. The original packet declared that naming the two impact_policy enum values was this slice's core deliverable. That was WRONG and the lane was right to refuse it. DD-49 (owner-ratified 2026-07-16, decisions.md around :660) decides the two MECHANISMS — apply the delta as an append-only signed obligation adjustment, or grandfather so the new price applies only to obligations created later — and then explicitly defers the naming: 'tên bảng/API cuối cùng chờ design-probe', with the Hệ quả clause requiring, BEFORE any schema or API work, a design-probe covering {price up/down} x {unpaid/partial/paid/refunded} x {leave/cancel/rejoin active/waitlisted/promotion} plus an activation-time idempotency key and a canonical balance helper. feature_payment_reconcile_tech.md:750 already carries that work as 'DD-49 correction/refund core (storage design-probe required)', and :757 repeats that schema/API names and idempotency keys must come from the design-probe. So the token belongs to the payments design-probe, not to a session docs slice. HOW THE ERROR HAPPENED, worth more than the correction: the owner searched the corpus for the TOKENS impact_policy and review_policy. DD-49 governs this exact question and never uses either string, so the search could not reach it. Searching by name finds where a name is used, not where the concept was decided.
_already_on_main_do_not_redeliver: Measured at 57dda43 before this packet was written, because an earlier draft of this acceptance matrix listed work that already exists. PRICE_CHANGE_REQUIRES_POLICY is ALREADY specified: feature_session_management_tech.md:283 carries the error row with its Vietnamese text, :733 carries the acceptance row 'Price change no policy -> PRICE_CHANGE_REQUIRES_POLICY', and feature_sessions_fe.md:348 carries the full t(vi, en) mapping. The fail-closed requirement is therefore already contract. Do NOT re-author any of it, and do NOT count it as delivered work. What is genuinely missing is exactly what feature_sessions_fe.md:400 says is missing: the request enum and the preview DTO.

_acceptance.A1: edge #4's impact_policy is stated as a REQUIRED caller choice between the two mechanisms DD-49 already decided — apply the delta as an append-only signed obligation adjustment, or grandfather so the new price binds only obligations created later — WITHOUT pinning a token, a request enum, or any per-charge-state disposition. Cite DD-49 as the authority for the two mechanisms and for the fact that their naming is deferred.
_acceptance.A2: where in edge #4's lock sequence the policy is consumed. The rule at :214 reads 'lock session -> root job -> roster/finance, THEN require explicit impact_policy', so the contract places the check under the lock, not before it. This is lock ordering, not money semantics, and is in scope.
_acceptance.A3: the boundary with review_policy in one sentence in the BE spec: impact_policy is a caller-supplied decision, review_policy is a system-forced deflection to human review, and neither substitutes for the other
_acceptance.A4: feature_sessions_fe.md's Save-is-blocked row and design-system.md:462's 'no impact_policy selector' row are reconciled to say the block waits on the DD-49 design-probe — NOT 'enum pinned' and NOT 'liftable on implementation'. The block is correct and stays; what changes is that its reason is now named and traceable.
_acceptance.A5: a forward pointer from the session spec to feature_payment_reconcile_tech.md:750 ('DD-49 correction/refund core, storage design-probe required') so the next reader finds the owner of the deferred half instead of re-deriving it
_acceptance.A6: the capacity branch of edge #4 — 'a capacity outcome that is full resolves roots in the same tx' — either stated as contract or explicitly deferred with the reason named. Prefer deferral if it cannot be stated without touching charge-state semantics.
